contentAutoUpdate.title: Automatic Content Updates
contentAutoUpdate.toggleError: Failed to update content auto-update setting.
contentAutoUpdate.invalidDataCap: Data cap must be 0 or a positive number of GB.
contentAutoUpdate.scheduleSaveError: Failed to save content update schedule.
contentAutoUpdate.autoDisabledFallback: Automatic content updates were disabled after repeated failures.
contentAutoUpdate.enableDescription: Automatically download newer versions of your installed Information Library content (ZIM files) and maps during your chosen window. Content downloads can be very large, so set a per-window data cap to limit how much is pulled at once. We recommend allowing at least 0.5 GB per update window to ensure most updates can be pulled in a timely manner, but you can set a lower cap if you have very limited bandwidth and don't mind some updates being skipped (they will still appear in the UI and can be updated manually). If an update repeatedly fails to download within the window, it will be automatically disabled and require manual intervention to re-enable.
